doc.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009

title: Playing over one's head
summary: Grimes says several times he was in over his head and kept playing.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: Henry did you ever get, in those days, playing with someone where you felt wow, I’m in way over my head here. I don’t know what to do with this musician?
Yeah. Can you remember who it might have been?

I couldn’t stop because you don’t want to be representing that kind of a sound. So I’d sort of like hang in there for as much as I could do. I didn’t have too much trouble but © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-
sometimes, if that happened to me, you know I had to work myself out of it, and keep playing. But that was still great.
